items.headline: $SOL Ships Native Payments Rail for Subscriptions
items.summary: Solana adds built-in recurring payments and allowance-style transfers, pushing $SOL deeper into consumer payments.

items.headline: $SOPH Ditches zkSync, Rebuilds as App Studio on Base
items.summary: After raising $60M but attracting under 200 daily users, $SOPH is shutting its zkSync chain and pivoting to consumer apps on Base.

items.headline: $ZEC ETF Files 3-for-1 Split as Inflows Surge
items.summary: Grayscale's $ZEC ETF announced a 3-for-1 forward share split following a $233M inflow surge, signaling rising demand for privacy coins.

items.headline: $LDO Completes Wind-Down of Simple DVT Module
items.summary: Lido has fully shut down its Simple DVT module, streamlining $LDO's staking infrastructure roadmap.

items.headline: $ETH Plan: MEV Elimination, Default Privacy, ETH Pay
items.summary: The Ethereum Foundation's interim ED laid out an execution plan targeting MEV removal, default privacy, and an $ETH payments push.
